subject: Future Tech
title: Supply Chain Disruption
description: A 60-second lesson on Supply Chain Disruption.

buildup.text: Within days, makers printed face shields, ventilator splitters, and nasal swabs to fill the gap at zero shipping cost.

discovery.text: Local 3D printing bypasses shipping delays, tariffs, and geopolitical risk. The factory moves to where the demand is.

twist.text: Quality control is harder when thousands of makers use different printers, settings, and materials with no standards.

punchline.text: A pandemic proved that local production beats global shipping.

quiz.question: What medical item did makers 3D-print most during the COVID-19 pandemic?
